playstyle.identity: Zyra is a zone control mage who spawns plants to attack enemies. Her ultimate creates a massive zone that knocks up after a delay.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive spawns seeds periodically. Q damages in a rectangle. W plants a seed (more seeds = more plants). E roots in a line. Abilities on seeds spawn plants. R creates a zone that knocks up when it ends. Place seeds, Q/E to spawn plants, R in teamfights.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Zyra spikes at level 6 with her zone control R. Liandry's makes plants burn. She's strong at zone control and teamfighting.

passive.name: Garden of Thorns
passive.details: Seeds periodically spawn near Zyra. They can be turned into plants by her abilities.

abilities.name: Deadly Spines
abilities.summary: Damage enemies in a rectangle; spawns plants from seeds.
abilities.details: Zyra grows thorns in an area, dealing damage. Seeds in the area become Thorn Spitters that attack enemies.

abilities.name: Rampant Growth
abilities.summary: Plant a seed; abilities hitting seeds spawn plants.
abilities.details: Zyra plants a seed that lasts for a short duration. Abilities hitting seeds spawn plants.

abilities.name: Grasping Roots
abilities.summary: Send roots that damage and root; spawns plants from seeds.
abilities.details: Zyra sends roots forward that root enemies. Seeds in the path become Vine Lashers that slow enemies.

abilities.name: Stranglethorns
abilities.summary: Create a zone of thorns; after a delay, knock up enemies inside.
abilities.details: Zyra summons a massive thicket that deals damage and enrages plants. After a delay, enemies inside are knocked up.
